نقتفي (form VIII)
# نَقْتَفِي (naqtafī) /naq.ta.fiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# نَقْتَفِيَ (naqtafiya) /naq.ta.fi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
